evidence.explanation: The explicit JS environment and RNG parameters preserve the tested fountain/sink/altar initializer behavior. This qualifies five call-delegation keys only in the finite regular-room domain.
evidence.proof: 132 successful-domain targets and132 no-free-position controls: fountain draws0..6,sink without a feature draw,altar draws0..2 ×OROOM/THEMEROOM ×three sample positions ×initial horizontalbit0/1. Exact C constructors, search/sampling, terrain setter and feature recount match actual exported JS constructors and sampler on terrain,horizontal/altar mask,feature counters,coordinate draw count and feature RNG bound/count. Fountain/sink retain C double-count quirk after recount.
evidence.control: The control room is entirely FOUNTAIN, so samplers fail after101 attempts; no feature mutation/draw follows. THEMERoom altar returns before sampling. Empty regular5×5room targets have no doors,traps,fluids,subrooms or invocation square, with one existing fountain/sink elsewhere. Private JS bydoor is extracted verbatim only for its required production hook. This is not all search geometry, invalid setter inputs, independent RNG or feature runtime.

evidence.explanation: JS visitSubrooms is the explicit continuation of C recursive postorder traversal. Its local stockRoom callable delegates to env.stockRoom or the imported stock_room; the test qualifies call dispatch and flags only, not stock_room implementation.
evidence.proof: 138 target comparisons and66 all-unfilled controls:11 room types,allowed no-fill/flag-only modes (ordinary/theme use normal instead of flag-only),one normal-shop configuration,three legal rectangular tree shapes up to depth2,and synchronous/Promise-resolved JS shop hooks. Exact C fill_special_room with a stock-call capture boundary matches exported JS on final9-bit level flags and ordered shop room/type/flag-before-call triples. Unfilled outer ordinary rooms still recurse into special children.
evidence.control: All-unfilled controls produce no flags or stock calls. C non-shop population helpers abort if reached; only flag-only special rooms and captured normal-shop dispatch execute. JS async callback controls verify the caller awaits child completion before continuing. No shop inventory,actors,actual stock_room contents,room-construction/storage,orig_rtype,global finalization or runtime behavior is compared.
